rows.scope: Travel taxonomy, part 2 (ROADMAP F1 detail): tag every place and trail on taxonomy v1. Passages per item from the shipped data, a candidate step (bi-encoder or BM25 top 25 labels, per the research subagent), a verifier only where uncertain through the AI gateway (Gemini or the box CPU per the E7 config, never the Claude API), a threshold per use, and place-level tags with evidence. Build it as a batch job (`run_pipeline.py` task) that writes a tag file under `data/` or `cache/`, not the wire (wiring tags into the wire and the app is a later task: register row). Score it with the taxonomy eval (`run.mjs taxonomy`) on the seed set; P@5 and F1 on the owner's 400 labels is an owner step after T1149-b. The full run on every item is a box run unless it is cheap enough here.
